meta.phase-name: Escape the Dungeon Level-Schema Runtime Integration

phase-plan.purpose: Make Escape the Dungeon consume the shared level schema outputs so the game and playthrough flows ride on the same authored topology baseline.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: runtime content resolution, dungeon-layout projection from level content, playthrough/replay consumers, and active content-pack usage. Out of scope: a full region-level gameplay simulation.
phase-plan.definition-of-done: Done when the game runtime can consume `levelContent` from active/generated packs and the docs-site gameplay surfaces continue to use the active authored bundle.

file.description: Projects authored level content into dungeon layouts for current gameplay needs.
Resolves content pack precedence between authored level content and explicit dungeon-layout overrides.
Loads the active authored bundle into the browser game iframe.
Creates and restores game bridges with authored content-pack overrides.

task.description: Teach the runtime to project authored level content into the current dungeon-layout gameplay path.
Keep docs-site and KAPLAY gameplay surfaces consuming the active authored bundle.
